description: A modern, elegant, and professional educational mobile app featuring an Indonesian nationalistic color palette (Red, White, Gold). Designed for students, prioritizing high legibility, respectful presentation of historical figures, and intuitive navigation.

icons.style: clean, slightly rounded, 24px default size, gold or red for active states

MainMenuGrid.layout: Bento grid layout. The 'Mulai Scan AR' button should be full-width on top to emphasize the core feature, followed by 2x2 grid for Daftar Pahlawan, Kuis, Panduan, Tentang.
MainMenuGrid.card_style: White background, medium border radius (16px), md shadow. Icons in gold or red.

ProgressTracker.layout: Horizontal progress bar below the user's greeting.
ProgressTracker.style: Gold (#D4AF37) fill on a light gray track. Text showing 'X/20 Pahlawan Dipelajari'.

ARViewerOverlay.layout: Absolute positioned over camera view. Use safe area insets.
ARViewerOverlay.controls: Glassmorphism pills or semi-transparent dark backgrounds (rgba(0,0,0,0.6)) to ensure visibility over the live camera.

HeroBiographyView.header_image: Full width, max height 40vh, slight gradient overlay at bottom for text contrast.
HeroBiographyView.content_container: White surface, border-top-radius 24px, negative margin top (-20) to overlap image. Contains Name, Title, Birthdate, and detailed history.
HeroBiographyView.title: Playfair Display, h2, text-main.
HeroBiographyView.audio_button: Floating Action Button (FAB) or prominent inline button, secondary color (Gold) background, with a Speaker icon for TTS.

HeroCard.title: Playfair Display, text-center, bold.
HeroCard.status: Small checkmark icon in green (#2A9D8F) if already studied.

QuizView.option_button: Outlined button default. On select: green for correct, red for incorrect, with slight shake animation on incorrect.
QuizView.score_modal: Gold medal icon, large score text, primary button to 'Ulangi Kuis' (Retry).

interactions_and_animations.page_transition: Slide in from right, fade out.
interactions_and_animations.list_items: Staggered fade in and slide up (use React Native Reanimated or standard LayoutAnimation).

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement UI using pure React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Image) or styling libraries like NativeWind/Tailwind if configured. Do not use HTML tags.
For typography, use expo-font to load 'Playfair Display' (serif, used for all headings/titles) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (sans-serif, used for all body text).
Ensure the AR Viewer supports permission requests for the Camera and maps overlay components correctly on top of it.
Ensure accessibility: sufficient contrast (Red on White is good, use dark gray instead of pure black for softer reading).
Use ScrollView for long content like biographies and ensure padding bottoms so content isn't cut off.
Add `testID` to all touchable elements for automated testing.
